paper_title: Optimized RNA interference therapeutics combined with interleukin-2 mRNA for treating hepatitis B virus infection
default_organism: mixed: Homo sapiens cell line; Mus musculus liver
main_interpretation: This dataset includes tLNP/siNC and tLNP/siHBV contexts in HepG2 cells at 16 h and mouse liver recorded at 72 h by GEO and supplementary RNA-seq Methods. The main-paper Figure 4e caption instead says 48 h for the mouse arm, so that arm remains source-conflicted. Weak IMRS can reflect cargo-specific therapeutic RNAi effects and context rather than pure delivery-induced acute innate activation; the cell-line arm is not late.

paper_title: Gene therapy with AR isoform 2 rescues spinal and bulbar muscular atrophy phenotype by modulating AR transcriptional activity
main_interpretation: This dataset profiles a late therapeutic disease-rescue/transgene-expression model in tibialis anterior muscle from SBMA AR100Q mice, with AAV9-AR45 and AAV9-GFP/untreated control contexts. It is not an acute vector-vs-control innate activation study.

paper_title: Parenteral vaccination with an adjuvanted mRNA vaccine induces protective mucosal immunity against rotavirus in neonatal mice
main_interpretation: This dataset profiles small intestine tissue from mice immunized with PBS, SM102-LNP, or Am80-LNP at day 14 after booster immunization. This is late mucosal/adaptive tissue biology; Am80-LNP is designed to promote gut mucosal immunity and mitigate injection-site inflammation.

paper_title: Early spatiotemporal evolution of the immune response elicited by adenovirus serotype 26 vector vaccination in mice
main_interpretation: This Ad26/Ad5 vector vaccination time-course spans muscle, draining lymph node, and blood. Weak external splits require exact tissue/time interpretation; 72 h splits can represent waning tissue-time kinetics rather than failure of acute innate activation.
